name: Guy Brighton
source:
Likes: Catching up with friends
Dislikes: Studying
Hobby: Playing sports
Skill: Ladilz

"You make me stronger. I need to fight for our sake."

Cerim: Guy's popular student at the academy.
He makes surroundings happy with his cheerfulness.
He has athletic side, and Ladilz is his thing.
But...he is not a big fan of studying, though.
So, he regularly goes to supplementary classes.
It seems like he just pretending not to show his true ability.
Maybe I think too much...
